diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default has an explicit depends_on entry for aws_s3_bucket.origin, but this ordering is already established implicitly via attribute references: the distribution's origin.domain_name comes from local.bucket_domain_name, which resolves through local.origin_bucket (origin_bucket_options.new = aws_s3_bucket.origin[0] when the module creates the origin bucket). Terraform infers the dependency from this data flow, so the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
